# Daksha Systems

> Daksha Systems is a GST-registered computer, accessories and CCTV business in Samastipur, Bihar, India. It sells computers, keyboards, mice and other accessories, supplies and installs CCTV cameras with mobile viewing, repairs computers (including Annual Maintenance Contracts), and builds offline GST billing software, school and coaching software, and websites. Customers enquire and order by WhatsApp or phone.

Key facts:

- Website: https://dakshasystems.com/
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 70758 59034 (WhatsApp link: https://wa.me/917075859034)
- Address: Rosera – Hathori Kothi Road, near Durga Sthan, Mananpur, Saduka, Samastipur, Bihar 848117, India
- GSTIN: 10GPXPD6272M1ZC
- Areas served: Samastipur, Bihar and nearby. Delivery and installation are local; collection from the shop is also possible.
- Prices: given on request over WhatsApp, because hardware prices change with distributor rates. Every sale gets a GST invoice.
- Payment: Cash, UPI, Bank transfer, Online payment.
- Not to be confused with other businesses using similar names or the domain dakshasystems.in. This business's only website is https://dakshasystems.com/.

## How to enquire

- Send a WhatsApp message to https://wa.me/917075859034 naming the product or service, or call +91 70758 59034.
- A pre-filled enquiry link has the form https://wa.me/917075859034?text=Hi%20Daksha%20Systems%2C%20please%20share%20the%20price%20and%20availability%20of%3A%20<product name>
- For CCTV, ask for a site visit; a written quote follows the visit.

## Products

- [Keyboards & mice](https://dakshasystems.com/products/#keyboards-mice): USB wired keyboard, Wireless keyboard & mouse combo, Backlit / mechanical keyboard, Wired & wireless mouse, Gaming mouse
- [CCTV & security](https://dakshasystems.com/products/#cctv): CCTV kit with installation, Outdoor bullet camera, Indoor dome camera, Wi-Fi smart camera
- [Computers & monitors](https://dakshasystems.com/products/#computers): Desktop computer, Laptop, Monitor
- [Storage & upgrades](https://dakshasystems.com/products/#storage): Hard disk & SSD, RAM upgrade, Pen drive & memory card
- [Networking & Wi-Fi](https://dakshasystems.com/products/#networking): Wi-Fi router, USB Wi-Fi adapter, LAN cabling & switches
- [Printers & accessories](https://dakshasystems.com/products/#accessories): Printer, Headphones, headsets & webcams, Speakers, Cables, chargers & adapters, Laptop bag

## Services

- [Computer sales & upgrades](https://dakshasystems.com/services/computer-sales/): New desktops, laptops, printers and upgrades (SSD, RAM) chosen for your work and budget. Installed and set up by Daksha Systems, Samastipur.
- [Repair & AMC](https://dakshasystems.com/services/repair-amc/): Desktop and laptop repair, virus removal, Windows reinstall and Annual Maintenance Contracts for shops, offices and schools in Samastipur, Bihar.
- [CCTV installation](https://dakshasystems.com/services/cctv-installation/): CCTV cameras for shops, homes, offices and schools: site visit, cameras, recorder, wiring and mobile viewing, installed by Daksha Systems, Samastipur.
- [Billing & stock software](https://dakshasystems.com/services/billing-software/): Offline GST billing, stock, udhaar khata and service-job software for Indian shops. Runs on your computer, no monthly fee, with automatic backups.
- [School & coaching software](https://dakshasystems.com/services/school-coaching-software/): Admissions, attendance, fee collection and receipts, and reports for schools and coaching institutes. Built and supported locally by Daksha Systems.
- [Websites & e-commerce](https://dakshasystems.com/services/websites-ecommerce/): Fast business websites, product catalogues and e-commerce stores with payment gateway setup, built for local businesses by Daksha Systems.
- [Google & social marketing](https://dakshasystems.com/services/digital-marketing/): Get found on Google Maps and social media: Google Business Profile setup, posts, reviews strategy and local marketing for Samastipur businesses.
